items.title: Visa Targets Secure AI Agent Payments Through Expanded Industry Partnership
items.summary: Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) announced on Tuesday that it expanded its Agentic Ready program to include merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), acquirers and commerce platforms, helping them prepare for transactions initiated by AI agents. The initiative, part of Visa Intelligent Commerce, launched with more than 140 participants, including Adyen, Antom, Billtrust, Checkout.com, Fiserv, Global Payments, PayPal and Stripe. items.title: What’s next for issuers after Fiserv cuts a debit network
items.summary: Fiserv CEO Takis Georgakopoulos said at Citi’s Fintech Conference that the technology company was consolidating its debit networks with the intent to sell or wind down the other. It’s a move that could have lasting implications on the debit card issuers and meaningfully shake up debit card routing dynamics.
